mike: quick alert 1:12 UTC: small p99 spikes on several racks post-packing. looks networky, not GPU.
jena: I see tx_queue jitter and a few retransmits. likely noisy egress coupling after slot compaction.
kevin: can we carve out a temporary SNAT for hot tenants and pin them to a different ToR? low-risk test.
ops-lead: +1. small canary then expand if tails drop.
kevin: running canary: 
```bash
redwoodctl network carve-snat --region eu-west --selector 'tier=hot' --percent 20 --dst-tor toR-backup
```
infra-bot: carve-snat started (id=cs-20260321-01)
mike: running probes; report in 15m.
